import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

index = 0
T = int(data[index])
index += 1

results = []

for _ in range(T):
    M = len(data[index])
    bottom_row = data[index]
    index += 1
    
    N = len(data[index])
    left_column = data[index]
    index += 1
    
    Q = int(data[index])
    index += 1
    
    queries = []
    for _ in range(Q):
        x = int(data[index]) - 1
        y = int(data[index + 1]) - 1
        queries.append((x, y))
        index += 2
    
    dp = [[0] * (M + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
    
    for i in range(1, M + 1):
        dp[0][i] = int(bottom_row[i - 1])
    
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        dp[i][0] = int(left_column[i - 1])
    
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        for j in range(1, M + 1):
            dp[i][j] = 1 - max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1])
    
    result = ''.join(str(dp[x][y]) for x, y in queries)
    results.append(result)

print('\n'.join(results))
